global_issues.title: Inflation data and Trump-Fed clash drive rate volatility
global_issues.note: Confirmed: 10-year Treasury yield near 4.75% (18-month high), 30-year above 5.20% (highest since 2007). Trump wants rate cuts while Bessent targets lower 10-year yields, creating policy tension. July CPI due Wednesday 2026-08-12, PPI Thursday. This remains current and accurate.

global_issues.title: Trump polysilicon tariffs and chip export enforcement escalate
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Trump signed Section 232 proclamation on 2026-08-06 imposing 15% tariffs plus minimum import prices on polysilicon/derivatives, though effective date is 2026-12-04 (120 days out), not immediate. Samsung/SK Hynix testing of Chinese (AMEC) etching tools reported by Reuters/Diplomat 2026-08 is accurate, though Samsung has publicly denied the testing claim — briefing should note this denial for balance.

grok_report.summary: Core facts checked out: AAPL ($304.91) and TSLA ($332.81) closing prices match reported figures exactly, and both cited global issues (Fed/Treasury yield tension, polysilicon tariffs) are substantively accurate. However, the briefing has a critical omission — the Iran/Strait of Hormuz oil crisis was the dominant driver of the 2026-08-11 session (oil >$83, tech stocks the biggest index drag) and is not mentioned anywhere, which undermines the market mood and sector narratives. NVIDIA's $500B AI financing news, directly relevant to two top watchlist names, is also missing.
